scope: Independent compilation/provenance verification of the new exact22-form layer and bounded source accounting; not independent recertification of all Sanskrit.
limitations: Source judgments and their reviewed adoption documents are treated as inputs; this check does not rederive all linguistic decisions.
Conditional bounds are historical accounting under unflagged keys and source decisions, not accuracy on repaired prompts and not bounds on undetected oracle defects.
The source-layer pending queue remains its immutable pre-accounting queue; the separate bounded audit supplies the later decisions.

critical_stem_caveat.decision: Keep the adopted short-Cada decision for this accounting; its linguistic certainty is not established by this compilation review.
critical_stem_caveat.uncertainty: Two printed editions and explicit lexical contrast support short Cada, while the electronic same-locus long reading has unresolved edition provenance. The numerical range is conditional on that choice.
critical_stem_caveat.nonadopted_sensitivity: Accepting 66 additional Opus Cada responses would raise canonical accuracy to 91.5%; this is not an adopted grade change and is outside the displayed six-hold/nonanswer interval.
